stem: A grower is mapping canopy PPFD. Which procedure best supports a repeatable comparison after a fixture adjustment?
choices: Measure the brightest center point before and after the adjustment because peak PPFD is the most sensitive indicator of layout change
Use the same grid locations, canopy height, and fixture settings before and after the change
Take a new set of random canopy readings after each adjustment and compare their average values
Compare fixture wattage and mounting height instead of repeating the canopy PPFD grid
rationale: A repeatable grid with consistent measurement height and operating conditions allows meaningful before-and-after comparison of canopy PPFD distribution.
